query: Uganda Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak 2026 latest confirmed case count July 2026, any new case after 20 cumulative
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

**Uganda Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) Outbreak 2026 — Case Count as of Mid-July 2026:**

- **Uganda's cumulative confirmed cases remain at 20** (including 2 deaths), stable through 13–14 July 2026.
- **No new confirmed case has been reported after the total reached 20.** The last confirmed case was detected on **21 June 2026** — roughly 3+ weeks without a new case.
- Breakdown: 15 imported (DRC travel-linked) + 5 local transmission cases; 16 recovered; all in the Kampala Metropolitan Area with no community transmission.
- Cross-validated across WHO DON612, WHO/ReliefWeb Situation Report 08, and ECDC.

For context, the DRC epicenter had 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths as of 13 July 2026, and WHO declared the outbreak a PHEIC on 17 May 2026.

**Direct answer:** There has been no new Uganda case beyond 20 as of mid-July 2026.

key_facts: Uganda cumulative confirmed Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) cases stood at 20 as of 13-14 July 2026, unchanged since late June.
No new confirmed case has been reported in Uganda after the total reached 20; the last confirmed case was 21 June 2026.
Uganda has recorded 2 confirmed deaths (plus 1 probable death noted by WHO DON612).
16 of the confirmed cases had recovered as of mid-July 2026.
Case breakdown: 15 imported (DRC travel-linked) + 5 local transmission cases; no documented community transmission.
All Ugandan cases were in the Kampala Metropolitan Area (Kampala and Wakiso districts).
WHO Situation Report 08 (data as of 5 July 2026) states Uganda reported no new confirmed cases in the prior week.
The outbreak epicenter is DRC (Ituri Province), with 1,963 confirmed cases and 719 deaths as of 13 July 2026.
WHO declared the outbreak a PHEIC on 17 May 2026; caused by Bundibugyo species, no approved vaccine or specific treatment.
